ios.title: Learn English in one calm, focused daily flow
ios.description: Switch between listen, speak, read, write and review without leaving your practice context. StepUp keeps every exercise, note and AI hint in one place.

web.description: Listen, speak, read, and write — with AI-powered feedback at every step. Import your own content and master English through immersive practice.

listen.title: Listen
listen.description: Listen to English articles, phrases, sentences, and words with adjustable speed and interactive transcripts.

speak.title: Speak
speak.description: Practice speaking with real-time speech recognition and get color-coded pronunciation feedback.

read.title: Read
read.description: Read English articles with interactive translation, word collection, and comprehension tracking.

write.title: Write
write.description: Practice typing English with real-time error correction, WPM tracking, and spaced repetition.

aiTutor.title: AI Tutor
aiTutor.description: Chat with an AI English tutor that knows your learning context and helps you improve.

footer: StepUp — Learn English by doing. Built with Next.js, Vercel AI SDK, and Web Speech API.
